Stats

Cat
Kira the Cat is a medium haired brown cat with blue eyes. She is in Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing.
“
It's your lucky day. I am receiving compliments at this time, and you are most welcome to make an offering.
„
— Kira

Involvement

If spoken with using  Speak with Animals, Kira gives the party information on the customers of Sharess' Caress. If a party member compliments her, or if they leave the initial conversation without saying anything, then a party member can speak her again. If the party insults or tries to pet her, she does not converse with them anymore.

Notes

  • Kira was named after the cat of a character artist that worked on the cat model, using her own cats as references. Kira sadly passed away during production and was put into the game by the developers so she could forever roam the streets of Baldur’s Gate.[1]
